title: This Massachusetts haunted hotel ranks among America's best
excerpt: USA TODAY recently named the Lizzie Borden House as one of the country's best haunted hotels and destinations. Here's what they said.
content:
Oct. 1, 2026, 5:11 a.m. ET

Looking for a truly haunted experience this spooky season? According to USA TODAY's 10BEST Readers' Choice Awards, Massachusetts is home to one of the best haunted hotels and destinations in the country.

The Lizzie Borden House, site of Fall River's infamous unsolved murder case from 1892, ranked twice in the 2026 Halloween awards, earning ninth place for best haunted destination and sixth place for best haunted hotel.

Here's what USA TODAY had to say about the top-rated haunted destination in Massachusetts.

What USA TODAY said about the Lizzie Borden House

"On August 4, 1892, one of the most grizzly unsolved murders took place at what is now known as the Lizzie Borden House," reads USA TODAY. "Nowadays, curious guests can check in to stay at the house, which is now a bed-and-breakfast, as well as go on house tours and ghost tours to learn more about its history, catch re-enactments of what may have occurred there, and learn all about its paranormal activities."

The historic home hosts several rooms furnished to look just as they did on the day of the murders, offering breakfast in the room where the autopsies took place and lodgings in the suite of Lizzie and her sister Emma, the former room of Lizzie's parents and the servant quarters of Bridget Sullivan, the maid who was in the house at the time of the murders.

Room rates at the Lizzie Borden House typically range from $200 to 400, with breakfast for an additional $20 per person. If you don't want to sleep with ghosts but still want to visit, the Lizzie Borden House also offers daily tours from 10:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at $30 a ticket, nightly ghost tours from 7 to 9 p.m. at $25 a ticket and nightly ghost hunts from 10 p.m. to midnight at $40 a ticket.

What other haunted destinations made the list?

Here is USA TODAY's full ranking of the top 10 haunted destinations in the country:

  1. Zak Bagans' The Haunted Museum – Las Vegas, NV
  2. Indiana State Sanatorium – Rockville, IN
  3. The Grove – Jefferson, TX
  4. Yuma Territorial Prison State Historic Park – Yuma, AZ
  5. Fort Mifflin on the Delaware – Philadelphia, PA
  6. Roads Hotel – Atlanta, IN
  7. Pioneer Saloon – Goodsprings, NV
  8. Randolph County Asylum – Winchester, IN
  9. Lizzie Borden House – Fall River, MA
  10. Lemp Mansion Restaurant & Inn – St. Louis, MO
